trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: What to do: make choices — the story offers them, and this trophy follows them. Where & how: play the story and decide at each big choice; PSN lists a count target of 500 for this trophy, but the official description does not say what the 500 counts, so treat it as a progress target to watch in-game rather than a count of choices. Missable warning: choices cannot be unmade in the same playthrough, so think before each big decision — keep a backup save before story choices if the game allows it. The official description names no specific choice, so no choice is pinned down here. Sources: Exophase PS5 Trophy List and PSNProfiles Trophy Tracking for the official name, description, grade and PSN count; the steps above are our own reading of that official description.
